speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. I see you are a newborn presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting; these are critical signs I must investigate carefully. Since we have already established the primary symptoms, I need to know: Is the vomiting projectile, and has there been any passage of stool since birth?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with midgut volvulus. This is a surgical emergency; please proceed immediately to the operating room for exploratory laparotomy. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_X-Ray.
